<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacation Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Supervisor receives request"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DecideRequest" name="Supervisor approves or rejects request"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestDecision" name="Request approved?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnApplication" name="Return application to employee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewRejection" name="Employee reviews rejection reasons"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Request rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyHR" name="Generate notification to Human Resources Representative"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresComplete" name="Management procedures complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_DecideRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_DecideRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_ReturnApplication">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Request is rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ReturnApplication" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_NotifyHR">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Request is approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHR" targetRef="Task_CompleteProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_CompleteProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacation Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_VacationRequest" name="Vacation request process starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive request as immediate supervisor">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DecideRequest" name="Approve or reject request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decide_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestDecision" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decide_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnApplication" name="Return application to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewRejection" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Rejection reasons reviewed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyHR" name="Generate notification to Human Resources Representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_Procedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_Procedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresComplete" name="Management procedures complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Submit" sourceRef="StartEvent_VacationRequest" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Register" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_DecideRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_ReturnApplication">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">requestRejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Review" sourceRef="Task_ReturnApplication" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_End" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_NotifyHR">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">requestApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Procedures" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHR" targetRef="Task_CompleteProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_End" sourceRef="Task_CompleteProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
